title: Proper and open factorization of the compact scalar map
statement: For a ring map a:C→D, a compactification c=(j,p) and K on X, the component of compactScalarMap(a,c) is the proper scalar mate at j_!K followed by Rp_* of the open coefficient comparison.

source.place: Construction 2.26 and the proper/open factorization preceding Proposition 2.29(2), pp. 15–16

proof.text: Unfold compactScalarMap and ExceptionalCoefficients.compactSupportMap. The component is definitionally the displayed composite.

from.place: First proof step: expand compactScalarMap as proper scalar mate followed by open balancing.

lean.statement:
theorem compactScalarMap_proper_open_factor
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing C] [CommRing D] (a : C →+* D)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule C X) :
    (compactScalarMap a c).app K =
      (scalarMate a c.g).app
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} C) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} D) c.g).rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso a c.i).hom.app K)
